'''Richard Upton Pickman''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Graveyard]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Luck]]
*+1 [[Speed]]

Your attacks are not affected by [[Physical Resistance]].

==Mythos Source==

Richard Upton Pickman first appears as the primary character in the story ''Pickman's Model'', written by H.P. Lovecraft (1926).

He also makes an appearance in "The Dream Quest of Unknown Kadath" (1927).
